newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam's Communist Party says membership booming.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam's Communist Party says membership booming.

text.p: Vietnam's Communist Party said on Thursday its membership levels were booming and reported figures showing more than 47,000 people had joined during the first half of this year.
The official Nhan Dan daily said 20 percent more people had joined this year than in the same period of 1996.
It said the biggest increase was recorded in southern areas of the country, which until 1975 fell under the administration of U.S.-backed South Vietnam.
Vietnam introduced free-market economic reforms in the late 1980s accompanied by widespread social changes. The Communist Party remains the country's sole legal political body.
